articles.title: India's snakebite crisis is killing tens of thousands every year
articles.summary: Devendra, an Indian farmer, recounts a snakebite incident sustained while picking mulberry leaves. He delayed hospital treatment for four days, highlighting critical issues in rural healthcare access and the importance of immediate medical attention for such emergencies. This personal experience likely sheds light on broader public health challenges faced by agricultural communities across India.

articles.title: Stocks in news: BEL, HAL, ITC, Hero MotoCorp, Anant Raj, Adani Green
articles.summary: Indian equity markets witnessed a sharp decline on Budget Day, primarily due to investors reacting to an increased securities transactions tax (STT) on futures and options. This policy change led to significant selling pressure. Analysts anticipate continued volatility in the markets, suggesting a period of uncertainty as investors adjust to the new tax regime and its potential impact on trading strategies.

articles.title: PM inaugurates civil terminal of Halwara airport, Mann says name it after Kartar Singh Sarabha
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually inaugurated the new civil terminal at Halwara airport in Ludhiana, Punjab. Developed at the existing IAF station, this project aims to boost regional connectivity and economic growth. Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann reiterated his demand for naming the airport. This initiative underscores national infrastructure development, leveraging defence facilities for civilian use and and enhancing civil-military cooperation.

articles.title: “Send Help,” “Iron Lung” Rule Box-Office
articles.summary: Sam Raimi's new film, 'Send Help,' achieved a strong opening at the box office, exceeding initial expectations. The dark comedy/survival horror movie earned $20 million on its debut weekend, securing the top spot. This performance highlights audience interest in the genre and provides a significant commercial start for the well-received production.

articles.title: Does AI already have human-level intelligence? The evidence is clear
articles.summary: In 1950, Alan Turing proposed the 'imitation game', now known as the Turing Test, in his paper 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence'. This landmark concept aimed to determine if a machine could exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from a human. Initially a hypothetical query, it evolved into a fundamental benchmark in artificial intelligence, shaping the development and understanding of machine capabilities and consciousness.

articles.title: 'What the f**k': Iron Lung creator puzzled as Markiplier's film adaptation quadruples its budget in one day, beating out Melania and Send Help at the box office
articles.summary: YouTube personality Markiplier is developing a movie adaptation of David Szymanski's acclaimed indie horror game "Iron Lung." This venture highlights digital creators' growing influence in mainstream entertainment. Aspirants can note how such adaptations significantly broaden a niche product's audience, potentially shifting its primary association from game to film, impacting public perception.
